verdict.rationale: Khoj is itself an AI assistant/agent: it chats, researches, runs code and lets users create custom agents. Serving tools to other agents through an MCP server is therefore a different product role. The evidence shows no 'mcp serve' mode or first-party hosted MCP endpoint that would make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
